required_events.event: Morning light spilled across Amy’s kitchen as she flipped pancakes while Will and Amber giggled at a small table.
A zombie burst through the back door, its eyes glowing red, slamming the front of the house with a wet thud.
Amy grabbed both kids by their shoulders and sprinted toward the basement hatch, pushing it open with her elbow before dropping them inside and slamming the lock behind them.
She stepped back onto the kitchen counter, breathing hard, then pulled a pistol and a katana from a hollow in the cabinet.
The zombies swarmed her in waves: one lunged at her wrist, another bit its arm; she shot each headshot and sliced each body with the blade.
More zombies kept arriving—one clattered through the door, two piled on the floor—but Amy kept them down one by one until the last zombie fell dead on the kitchen tiles.
She wiped sweat from her brow and stepped out of the kitchen into the stairwell again.
With Will and Amber in hand, they climbed up to the living room together.

phases.required_end_state: End at the expanded story's stated conclusion.
